newsitem.title: USA: Photran says China partner cancels contract.
newsitem.headline: Photran says China partner cancels contract.

text.p: Optical products company Photran Corp said Wednesday it received notice from its Chinese joint venture partner, the Shenzhen WABO Group Co Ltd, that WABO plans to terminate the contract under which Photran was to supply equipment to the venture.
WABO has also notified Photran that it is seeking a refund of about $1.7 million, plus interest, which it paid to Photran on behalf of the venture, Photran said.

"We do not know why WABO has canceled the contract. However, we believe it resulted from their inability to meet the payment terms specified in the unratified agreement we reached on November 8, 1996," Photran chief executive David Stevenson said in a statement. "We are reviewing Photran's rights under the agreement to determine what recourse the company may have against WABO. We do not intend to make any refund to WABO until we have concluded a comprehensive settlement of open issues."
"It is not possible at this time to determine the full impact of this event on the company's financial condition, although we do not anticipate any material adverse effect," Stevenson said.
Photran shares closed up 1/8 at 4-1/2 Wednesday.
